pre_mortem: Mitchell's under loses because the three-game carry sample concealed a role change that the missing injury and inactive reports would have revealed. Philadelphia taking an early lead could also expand its rushing volume, and one explosive run can beat this line despite few carries. Burks' over loses because air yards do not guarantee catches: Washington can lead through its rushing attack, spread limited passing volume among Okonkwo, Diggs and Williams, or miss Burks on his downfield chances. His 139 aggregate yards may also be concentrated in one game; the pack cannot test that. Both counter-cases limit confidence, and neither leg has a verified pricing edge.
slip_story: Conditional two-leg story: Washington produces enough early passing success for Burks, then protects a lead while Philadelphia's limited Mitchell rushing role persists. Do not force a 3–4-leg main slip from only two supported candidates. Treat these as research leans rather than a price-validated parlay; no TDs, no duplicate player markets, and no bet placement.
